 Ace Bailey Props Today: Points, Rebounds, Assists, 3-Pointers
 BetMGM 
 Nov 17, 2026, 3:28 PM 
 min read 
 Ace Bailey and the Utah Jazz face the Los Angeles Clippers on Tuesday, Nov. 17. Tip off is scheduled for 10:40pm ET at Intuit Dome in Inglewood.
 You can find BetMGM’s prop bet markets for Bailey below, including points, rebounds, assists, and three-pointers.
 Key Prop Bet Markets
 Ace Bailey Points: 13.5
 Ace Bailey Assists: 1.5
 Ace Bailey Rebounds: 5.5
 Ace Bailey Points + Rebounds + Assists: 21.5
 Ace Bailey 3-pointers: 1.5
 Ace Bailey Points: Over/Under
 The sportsbook has set Bailey’s point total at 13.5.
 Bailey scored 7 points in his last game (vs. the Spurs on Nov. 15) and is averaging 11.0 points in 2 career games against the Clippers.
 Ace Bailey Assists: Over/Under
 The sportsbook has set Bailey’s assists total at 1.5.
 Bailey had 4 assists in his last game (vs. the Spurs on Nov. 15) and is averaging 1.0 assists in 2 career games against the Clippers.
 Ace Bailey Rebounds: Over/Under
 The sportsbook has set Bailey’s rebounds total at 5.5.
 Bailey had 8 rebounds in his last game (vs. the Spurs on Nov. 15) and is averaging 2.5 rebounds in 2 career games against the Clippers.
 Ace Bailey Points + Rebounds + Assists: Over/Under
 The sportsbook has set Bailey’s points + rebounds + assists total at 21.5.
 Bailey had 19 total points, rebounds and assists in his last game (vs. the Spurs on Nov. 15) and is averaging 14.5 total points, rebounds and assists in 2 career games against the Clippers.
 Ace Bailey 3-pointers: Over/Under
 The sportsbook has set Bailey’s made three-point field goals at 1.5.
 Bailey had 1 three-pointer in his last game (vs. the Spurs on Nov. 15) and is averaging 2.0 three-pointers in 2 career games against the Clippers.
 Ace Bailey Key Stat Trends
 Bailey has averaged 17.3 points in his last four games.
 Bailey scored 20 points in his most recent appearance against the Clippers on January 27.
 Bailey has averaged 6.5 rebounds this season.
 Bailey has averaged only 2.5 rebounds in his two career appearances against the Clippers.
 Bailey has averaged 2.5 assists in his last two games.
 Bailey has averaged 2.5 three-pointers in his last four games.
 Bailey made 4 three-pointers in his most recent appearance against the Clippers.
